asset_description: Control plane of the ap-south-1-cluster EKS cluster, using IAM/OIDC and Kubernetes RBAC to decide who may create or change workloads. Control-plane audit logging is enabled. The public endpoint is open to 0.0.0.0/0 and the audit logs are not analysed by GuardDuty. Source: INF-01. Component: EKS platform.

Five private node groups of about 22 Graviton EC2 instances running all platform workloads. Each node exposes its OS, kubelet and the instance metadata endpoint (IMDS). Source: INF-02. Component: EKS platform.

The single internet entry point: a layer 4 NLB on port 443 with no WAF or CloudFront in front, terminating into the in-cluster Envoy TLS and layer 7 router. Source: WL-01. Component: Cloud API front door.
API gateway behind Envoy that runs the authentication plugins, rate limiting and request routing for /core/v2, /data/v2 and /pandora/v1. Source: WL-02. Component: Cloud API front door.
GraphQL data API over the core database, with role and tenant permission rules deciding which rows and fields each caller may read or change. Source: WL-03. Component: Cloud API front door.

Aurora PostgreSQL database holding core platform records, including the role, policy and tenant bindings that the platform's authorization decisions read. Source: DS-01. Component: Cloud API front door.
Aurora PostgreSQL database holding the update-instruction signing service state: installed ECU versions per vehicle and campaign targeting. Source: DS-02. Component: Deep Updater (OTA).

Aurora PostgreSQL database holding provisioning and device-identity state: which vehicle identities are enrolled and how each binds to a device certificate. Source: DS-03. Component: Device provisioning & PKI.
